statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail). Let letters(w) be the set of bytes occurring in w. Then r is the maximum of the set {0} ∪ { len(words[i]) * len(words[j]) | 0 <= i < j < len(words) and letters(words[i]) ∩ letters(words[j]) = ∅ }. Equivalently: (a) for every i and j with 0 <= i < j < len(words) and letters(words[i]) ∩ letters(words[j]) = ∅, len(words[i]) * len(words[j]) <= r; and (b) either r = 0 and there is no such pair (i,j), or there exist i and j with 0 <= i < j < len(words), letters(words[i]) ∩ letters(words[j]) = ∅, and len(words[i]) * len(words[j]) = r.
preconditions: 2 <= len(words) <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(words), 1 <= len(words[i]) <= 1000 and every byte of words[i] is a lowercase English letter (97 <= byte <= 122).
